plans.idea: Classic left-to-right leaderboard: bottle anchors the left edge, a wide text column carries the headline and its copy, the 'Taste the Difference' pill sits as the call to action on the right, and the logo lockup plus legal close out the far right edge.

Brand-first sign-off: the logo lockup and legal open on the left like a masthead, the headline block runs through the centre, then the CTA pill, and the bottle closes the strip on the right as the product payoff.

Product-led with the CTA pinned to the far right: the bottle sits beside the headline as one group, the brand lockup and fine print form a quiet middle band, and the pill button ends the reading path at the right edge where banner eyes finish.
